recent_posts.summary: String interpolation is a powerful feature in C# that allows developers to embed expressions inside string literals. It provides a more readable and concise way to format strings compared to traditional string formatting. The evolution of string interpolation from C# 6 to C# 11 has brought various improvements, such as performance enhancements, conditional interpolation, format specifiers, raw string literals, and new line support. Interpolated strings are advantageous as they enhance code readability, reduce the need for additional placeholders, and support any expression type.
